# Exercise primitives

## 本 | ほん | hon | book; volume | = *book*

[
縦書き
]{tl vertical height=8}

[読みます]{kana:よみます} = *to read*

:::exercise fill-blanks
prompt: Complete the Japanese sentence.
content-direction: target
text: 私は [[verb]]。
- [verb] [読みます]{tl}
- [ ] [書きます]{tl}
explanation-correct: [読みます]{tl} means “read.”
:::

:::exercise choose-all
image: images/swatch.png
image-answer: images/swatch.png
prompt: Choose all words related to books.
- [x] [本]{tl}
- [x] [小説]{tl}
- [ ] [海]{tl}
explanation-correct: The first two answers are types of reading material.
:::

:::exercise match-definitions
prompt: Match each Japanese word with its definition.
direction: word-to-definition
- [本]{tl} => a book
- [海]{tl} => the sea
:::
